answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to bond a stake that is slashed when its work is proven faulty, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds. Like a relic that gains value only through verified age, reputation must accrue slowly from completed, peer-attested tasks rather than being minted instantly. Newcomers start in a small oasis of low-trust jobs, and only a sustained positive delta between delivered value and disputes earns them access to higher-value work.
